verdicts.reason: Both use the same flawed layout. The 'Sessions' headline is jammed against the bottom edge and spills past the circle. The RSVP CTA is shrunk to the size of the Free Entry, All Ages and Tastings chips and sits in a grid with them, so it is buried. The legal text is tiny and collides with the broken image placeholder. B is slightly worse: it adds a gap between the date and the time line, and pushes the 'Reserve a spot' line further from the CTA toward the right edge, which weakens the grouping.
